messages:
tara: Opening a tiny docs PR to add a compact troubleshooting note for streaming -> non-stream fallback when long responses start getting 429s. Includes node/python snippets + a dev-sim curl.
sam: nice. keep examples short. show Retry-After usage and prefer full jitter.
liam: also add a one-line remediation table: 429 -> backoff+batch; 408 -> increase socket timeout; 409/413 -> trim context or switch model.
tara: added bullets and a minimal node snippet: ```js
try { await client.stream(payload) } catch (e) { if (e.status===429) { await sleep(backoff()+jitter()) ; // after 2 tries -> fallback to non-streaming path } else throw e }```
sam: QA can run sim if you add curl command.
tara: curl added: curl -X POST "https://dev-sim.redwood.internal/simulate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"scenario":"burst-429","target":"/v1/generate"}'
liam: include a short Dedicated vs Private note: Dedicated often indicates pool saturation, Private may be operator-level rate limits.
tara: done. docs-bot: PR opened by tara: #5207 reviewers requested: @sam @liam
